description: Defines the MasqueClientSession class and related interfaces for managing QUIC client sessions connecting to a MASQUE proxy, including encapsulated UDP/IP sessions and associated state management.

classes.name: MasqueClientSession
classes.description: Manages QUIC client sessions connecting to a MASQUE proxy, supporting encapsulated UDP and IP sessions, with state management for each request.

classes.name: MasqueClientSession::Owner
classes.description: Interface for owners of MasqueClientSession to receive notifications such as settings received.

classes.name: MasqueClientSession::EncapsulatedClientSession
classes.description: Interface for encapsulated UDP client sessions, handling packet processing and connection closure.

classes.name: MasqueClientSession::EncapsulatedIpSession
classes.description: Interface for encapsulated IP client sessions, handling IP packet processing, connection closure, and capsule events.

classes.name: MasqueClientSession::ConnectUdpClientState
classes.description: Maintains state for each CONNECT-UDP request, including stream and session references.

classes.name: MasqueClientSession::ConnectIpClientState
classes.description: Maintains state for each CONNECT-IP request, including stream and session references.

methods.name: MasqueClientSession
methods.description: Constructor initializing a MasqueClientSession with configuration, connection, and owner.

methods.name: SendPacket
methods.description: Sends an encapsulated UDP packet to a target address.

methods.name: GetFakeAddress
methods.description: Generates and registers a fake local address mapped to a hostname.

methods.name: RemoveFakeAddress
methods.description: Removes a previously generated fake address.
